message.content:
**"Buenos días, equipo"**

A quick note: if you're addressing a group you're close with (common in some Latin American workplaces), you might also hear the more casual "Buenos días, gente" or "Buenos días a todos" — but "equipo" is the standard, professional choice for "team."
